articles.title_en: Putin claims that Ukraine has no ‘antidote’ to Russia’s new jet-powered drones. Kyiv has already shown it can shoot them down, but doing it at scale could cost billions.
articles.lead_en: Speaking to reporters on the sidelines of the Cultural Forum, Vladimir Putin said Ukraine was seeking an “air ceasefire” out of weakness — especially because it feared Russia’s new jet-powered drones. The Russian president believes Kyiv has no “antidote” to these weapons.

articles.title_en: Russia attacks Kyiv again with missiles and drones, sparking fires at an educational facility and the roof of a five-story apartment building
articles.lead_en: Russian forces attacked Kyiv with missiles and drones overnight on September 29, Ukraine’s Air Force said. Several districts were hit, Mayor Vitali Klitschko said.

articles.title_en: Fire at pyrotechnics warehouse kills 14 in Russia’s Yaroslavl region, damages nine apartment buildings
articles.lead_en: A major fire broke out at a pyrotechnics warehouse in the village of Kubrinsk in Russia’s Yaroslavl region on the afternoon of September 28.

articles.title_en: More than 650,000 people left without water in Russia’s Far East after substation outage
articles.lead_en: The Shtykovo substation in Primorsky Krai’s Shkotovsky district went offline, shutting down four pumping stations and cutting off cold water to more than 650,000 people, the regional branch of Russia’s Emergency Situations Ministry said.

articles.title_en: Russian strike on apartment building in Kharkiv, Ukraine, injures 25 people, including nine children, regional governor says
articles.lead_en: A Russian strike overnight on September 28 destroyed a section of an apartment building in Kharkiv’s Saltivskyi district. Twenty-five people, including nine children, were injured, according to Kharkiv Governor Oleh Syniehubov.
